{{Quote|Vortex 4, come in. We've got a strange signal coming in from that area. Can you check it out and let us know what you find? Arda Base, out.|[[Yalor (Sullustan)|Yalor]], to [[Jerrod Lourdas]]|<ref name="OAA1" />}}
'''Arda Base''', also known as the '''Arda I base''',  was established several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by the [[Ardan resistance]] before becoming a key [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] outpost in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

==Layout==
{{Quote|Arda Base, this is Vortex 4 returning from patrol. All clear as usual. Ready for access sequence.''"<br />"''Thank you, Vortex 4, initiating computer auto-guidance now.|[[Jerrod Lourdas]] and [[Arda Base Control]]|<ref name="OAA1" />}}
[[File:Rebel_Base_Entrance_OaAI.png|thumb|left|220px|A pair of Kihraxz assault fighters parked outside the auxiliary hangar.]]
Arda Base was established in the [[The Gauntlet (Arda I)|the Gauntlet]], a long, twisting canyon on [[Arda I]]. The main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] was part of the cave system in the canyon, and was two [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] wide. The habitation area consisted of dormitories and dozens of rooms for [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. The mess hall served as a lounge in the off-hours. The base also contained a [[Medical bay/Legends|medbay]] and command and control section, as well as an armory and auxiliary hangar, which housed at least two [[Kihraxz assault fighter]]s.

==History==
Arda Base was established by the [[Ardan resistance]] led by [[Ran Niall]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], and became a key site for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] outpost. The base's location was leaked by the traitor [[Var Narek]] a few weeks after the Battle of Yavin. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent a large force to [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] the base. It was eventually destroyed when the Rebels sabotaged the main power core.
